name: Get to the bottom of something

meaning.zh:
“彻底查清某事” 或 “弄清事情的真相”。

这个短语最初用来形容矿工逐渐挖到矿井的底部，旨在寻找地下的矿脉。比喻为，在当前情境中，指通过细致调查或分析，找到问题的根源或揭示事件的真相。
meaning.en: The phrase originally described miners gradually digging to the bottom of a mine shaft to find veins of valuable minerals. Metaphorically, it means making a thorough investigation or analysis to uncover the root cause of a problem or to reveal the true nature of an event.

lines.en: The detective will not rest until he gets to the bottom of the mystery.
lines.zh: 这位侦探不会休息，直到彻底查清这个谜案为止。

lines.en: We need to get to the bottom of why the project failed.
lines.zh: 我们需要弄清楚项目失败的真正原因。

lines.en: He is determined to get to the bottom of the issue and find a solution.
lines.zh: 他决心彻查这个问题并找到解决办法。
